name: Meeting Notes
description: Go from a recording or a pile of Office files to a durable record: transcribe the meeting, take structured notes, convert the source documents to Markdown, and file the outcome in Notion.
description_zh: 把一场会或一堆 Office 文件变成能查的记录：先转录，再整理成有条理的纪要，把原始文档转成 Markdown，最后归到 Notion 里。
